dialog_checklist.source_command: exec dialog --no-shadow --title 'Checklist' --checklist 'Features' 17 60 8 a Alpha on b Beta off c Gamma on d Delta off

dialog_menu.source_command: exec dialog --no-shadow --title 'Menu' --menu 'Choose item' 15 52 6 a Alpha b Beta c Gamma d Delta e Epsilon

dialog_msgbox.source_command: exec dialog --no-shadow --title 'Trace message' --msgbox 'Hello from dialog.\nSecond line: λ界.' 10 50

dialog_radiolist.source_command: exec dialog --no-shadow --title 'Radio' --radiolist 'Select one' 15 52 6 a Alpha on b Beta off c Gamma off

dte_line_numbers.source_command: exec dte -c 'set no-save-on-exit true' -c 'set display-line-numbers true' sample.py

sqlite_box.source_command: sqlite3 -box ':memory:' "with t(id,name) as (values(1,'alpha'),(2,'βeta'),(3,'界')) select * from t;"

sqlite_column.source_command: sqlite3 -column -header ':memory:' "select 1 as id, 'alpha' as name union all select 22, 'longer value';"

sqlite_explain.source_command: sqlite3 ':memory:' "create table t(a integer primary key,b text); explain select b from t where a=4;"

sqlite_json.source_command: sqlite3 -json ':memory:' "select 1 as id, 'alpha' as name union all select 2, '界';"

sqlite_markdown.source_command: sqlite3 -markdown ':memory:' "select 'λ' as greek, '界' as wide union all select 'beta','日本語';"

sqlite_recursive.source_command: sqlite3 -box ':memory:' "with recursive n(x) as (values(1) union all select x+1 from n where x<12) select x, printf('%.*c',x,'*') as bar from n;"

sqlite_table.source_command: sqlite3 -table ':memory:' "select 'left' as side, 10 as amount union all select 'right', 200;"
